text_block_list.text:
Grass Wonder was able to achieve
splendid results in her "first three years" of the Twinkle Series.

On a peaceful day,
after reaching that milestone—

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: —And that is why...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Now that things have settled down a bit,
why don't we all head to the mountains~?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: ¿Qué?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Unya?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: The mountains... as in, actual mountains?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I was thinking we could all go on an excursion together
before El heads overseas~.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Man, that took me by surprise. That was pretty
sudden, coming from you, Grass-chan~.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Still, going out with everyone really does make me happy!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Yes! And doing it all for El's sake,
I'm so touched, thrilled, and moved—

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
No, I just suggested it
because I wanted to make memories with everyone~.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: That denial was way too faaast!
choice_data_list: Are you sure it was okay for me to come along too?
Are you sure it was okay to bring me along too?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Of course! I absolutely need
my Trainer there with me~

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu, I'm looking forward to it♪

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Now then~, well then, let us head toward the mountain trail entrance~!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Ooh!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Man, Grass-chan sure looks
way more cheerful than usual.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Mmm... It's so frustrating to think that smile
is because she's won so many races...!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Though... well, it is true that smiling so
fluffily like that suits Grass best, yes.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Even so?! Someday?! This El will definitely turn that fluffy smile into a face of bitter defeat—

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Ailes~?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
If we poke around, the sun will go down!!
Everyone, let's run toward the mountain!!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Oh, a race? Sounds good, sounds good~

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: So the last one to arrive carries the bags! See ya~!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
What a terrifying penalty to spring on me out of nowhere?!
Sei-chan, you are truly something else...!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Hold it right theeeere, DEEEEESU!!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? What!?
H-Hold on, everyone~!!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Mmmgh...! Alright!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I'm not gonna lose either, you know!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Ah... Geez, everyone here really hates losing, don't they~

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer?
Whatever you want to say is written all over your face~

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Oh, hehehe.
choice_data_list: Aren't you going to chase them?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: That's true~, but today is totally fine.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Today, I've resolved to cherish
every single step I take...

Along with Grass Wonder,
I take a leisurely stroll down a grassy ridge path.

Step by step... feeling the solid earth beneath both feet,
truly savoring the sensation of moving forward.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: "No path lies before me; a path is made behind me."

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
—From the moment I first ran upon the turf,
I knew with certainty that this was the path I was meant to walk.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
And if I were to walk this path, I decided I would go all the way.
All the way to reaching the absolute peak.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
...I thought I'd be able to walk in a straighter line,
at first.
choice_data_list: Was it actually all twisty and winding?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Yes... Exactly as you say.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Stumbling over my own inexperience, exasperated by my own insignificance.
And sometimes, even getting scolded by that girl.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
...To be honest, there were nights when I wondered
if such clumsy steps could ever lead to the pinnacle.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: However, things are different now.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
There's Maruzen-san, and Sei-chan.
There's Suzuka-senpai, El, and Spe-chan...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
There are so many other people too.
—And Trainer is here.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
That path is the one I must walk.
A path that no one else can take, mine alone.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
And eventually, this road will lead to a beyond
that only I can reach.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"So, hold your head high.
Take each step firmly and keep moving forward."

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: —Toward the pinnacle!
